reason: I give creators a free meal for a post and that works fine for me. I've never paid a creator cash, and I'm not going to start paying ₹5,000 plus a fee on top just because there's a promo code to count customers.
objection: Barter costs me a plate of food. This means paying cash plus 10% plus GST. Three 'influencer agencies' have already come to me this year with the same kind of promise.
would_change_my_mind: If it let me do barter deals and still track the customers with the code, free, I would try it. If I then saw a creator bring in enough paying customers to cover the fee, I might think about cash.
